description.p: Media Tools shrinks your videos and photos without visible quality loss, and works fully offline. Pick files or a whole folder, press Start, and the results go into a new folder next to the originals.

ul.li: Compress video: H.265 at a quality matched by measurement, with optional fast GPU encoding
Web video: H.264 MP4 that starts playing in any browser before it has fully downloaded
Video to frames: save a video's frames as JPEG or WebP images
Compress images: smaller JPEG, PNG and WebP files, plus a WebP copy of each image

description.p: Phone metadata, rotation and HDR colour are kept. Originals can be moved to the Trash once each copy is checked and confirmed smaller, and work can be paused, stopped or left running in the background.
First release: compress video, web video, video to frames and compress images.
